Every celebration has a story. My job is to make sure everyone remembers it. It was an absolute pleasure to anchor and emcee the beautiful "25th Wedding Anniversary Celebration" of Vanita & Vijendra at Keibaa x All Saints.

From the very first welcome to the final round of applause, the evening was filled with energy, spontaneous laughter, interactive games, heartfelt moments, music, and a dance floor that simply refused to slow down. Watching 100+ guests transform from "just attending" to becoming part of the celebration is exactly why I love what I do.

A big thank you to Vanita & Vijendra for trusting me with such a milestone celebration. Your warmth and your trust made the evening truly special.

If you're planning a wedding, sangeet, anniversary, birthday, corporate event, or private celebration, don't settle for someone who simply speaks on stage. Choose an event planner and emcee who can read the room, connect with every age group, and create unforgettable moments.

From 'one of a kind' themes, customized communications, complex logistics to last minute requests by wedding guests, ANR navigated the entire process in a calm, meticulous and efficient manner.

Ankit and Neha are experienced and very client-first throughout the process. ANR's existing relationships with major venues and providers made our wedding and reception planning smoother. They coordinated seamlessly with various teams at our destination wedding venue, negotiated with decorators and vendors, identified artists and vendors who matched our wavelengths and were also happy to work with service providers we had selected ourselves. The ANR team is very detail oriented, methodical and experienced. They brought order to chaos on several occasions. Ankit is extremely patient, a great advisor and is willing to go the extra mile, often offering to take additional tasks off our plate and come up with ideas that enhanced our vision for our events.

As someone running a business in the services industry it is really important how you make people feel - Ankit, Neha and their team did an incredible job at that for us, our close families and guests. What we were impressed by is their ability to always listen first and solve problems with initiative. Our wedding felt magical, and we credit ANR for sprinkling fairy dust on our special day.

Every ceremony, function, and activity throughout the wedding was planned meticulously and executed flawlessly, ensuring that everything ran smoothly and on time. This allowed our family members and guests to fully relax, participate, and enjoy every moment of the celebrations without any stress. The coordination and décor across all events were elegant and thoughtfully done, adding charm and warmth to the entire experience. The food was outstanding in both taste and presentation and received immense appreciation from all our guests. The energy of the celebrations was taken to another level by the incredible DJ and dhol team, who created a lively and festive atmosphere and kept everyone engaged and dancing throughout. A very special and heartfelt thanks to Prasad and his wonderful photography team, who captured every beautiful emotion, candid moment, and special memory so perfectly, giving us memories we will treasure for a lifetime. What truly set ANR apart was the constant support, hands-on involvement, and dedication shown by Ankit, Neha, and the entire team at every step, always being available and ensuring that even the smallest details were taken care of. Their passion, commitment, and personal touch turned our wedding into a seamless, joyful, and unforgettable celebration for us and our families. We are immensely grateful to ANR Wedding Planners and Prasad’s team for making our wedding journey so smooth, special, and truly memorable.
From the Groom and family ❤️🥰🎉
